topics.title: Jobs report calms markets
topics.summary: U.S. stocks rose near record levels after September hiring came in softer than expected, easing worries that stronger growth would add more inflation pressure.
topics.discussionPrompt: When markets cheer a cooler jobs report, who calls that practical economics and who says it feels a little backwards?

topics.title: Campaign season hits Alabama
topics.summary: President Trump planned an Alabama campaign stop as midterm races accelerate, while economic worries and election security remain prominent themes in national politics.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a campaign rally comes to town, who gets swept up in the spectacle and who mostly watches the parking situation?

topics.title: Amazon policy faces election test
topics.summary: Brazil's presidential election could reshape Amazon rainforest policy, with candidates offering sharply different approaches to conservation, development and deforestation controls.
topics.discussionPrompt: When an election could affect a rainforest, who talks climate first and who asks what local communities need day to day?

topics.title: Borneo villages face water stress
topics.summary: In Indonesian Borneo, months of dry weather and peatland fires have left some river-dependent communities buying water as El Nino conditions intensify local strain.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the river you rely on suddenly isn't usable, who starts with emergency fixes and who thinks about the bigger land-use picture?

topics.title: Fast trip reaches space station
topics.summary: Four astronauts reached the International Space Station on an unusually quick SpaceX Dragon flight, setting a U.S. express-flight mark for crew arrivals.
topics.discussionPrompt: If your commute to orbit took eight hours, who packs snacks like it's a road trip and who keeps saying science is wild?

topics.title: Israel plans repatriation flights
topics.summary: Israel said it would begin flights to bring home passengers stranded in the UAE after commercial travel was suspended following an attempted attack on a Tel Aviv-bound flight.
topics.discussionPrompt: When travel suddenly stops, who turns into the calm logistics person and who keeps refreshing the airline app every minute?

topics.title: California race tests GOP hopes
topics.summary: Republican Steve Hilton faces long odds in California's governor race, where Democrats have dominated statewide offices for two decades.
topics.discussionPrompt: In a state where one party usually wins statewide, who believes in surprise upsets and who wants to see the numbers first?

topics.title: Power plant rule challenged
topics.summary: States and cities sued over the EPA's repeal of greenhouse gas limits for coal and gas power plants, arguing the rollback weakens major climate protections.
topics.discussionPrompt: When energy rules change, who focuses on cleaner air, who worries about power bills, and who wants both in the same plan?

topics.title: Baseball day games draw thin crowds
topics.summary: MLB's afternoon Wild Card games in Atlanta and Houston drew lighter crowds, underscoring the challenge of filling seats during weekday work and school hours.
topics.discussionPrompt: If playoff baseball starts in the afternoon, who calls in mysteriously busy and who says highlights after dinner are enough?

topics.title: AI security review widens
topics.summary: Reuters reported OpenAI notified more than 100 organizations about unauthorized activity tied to AI agents, highlighting fast-growing security questions around automated tools.
topics.discussionPrompt: When AI tools can act on someone's behalf, who gets excited about convenience and who immediately asks where the guardrails are?
